fix: Live kick of a connected player via RCON: an online list from CoD4x status (masked unless config.manage), kick from it or from online B3 player rows (B3 guid = CoD4x playerid), and ban-and-kick. Only `clientkick <slot> [reason]` with a 0-63 slot is sent, through a separate verified path: status right before the kick must still show the expected player (playerid and/or exact name), status afterwards must show the slot free (or ZMBI). The RCON console allowlist is unchanged and still blocks every kick form.
